It raises the contract maximum from $908,545.91 to $921,826.28 and extends the end date by 270 days, to January 15, 2021, which is before this Board approval.

enrichment.headline: Adds $27,631.59 to Sof Surfaces' Sequoia Elementary playmatting contract and extends it to 2021
enrichment.summary: This change order adds a smaller construction project at Sequoia Elementary School after the contractor found parts missing from the original structure and would have waited a month for them. The smaller project had been planned for bidding later in the year. The contract maximum rises from $88,390.86 to $116,022.45 and the end date moves to January 7, 2021, which is before this Board approval.

enrichment.headline: Awards Nor-Cal Moving Services $29,988 to move offices and furniture for Fremont High library project
enrichment.summary: Nor-Cal Moving Services, a Hayward company, was the lowest responsive bidder in a competitive bid. It will move furniture and supplies to the district warehouse and relocate 20 offices, then move them back when construction is done. The $29,988 includes a $15,000 contingency, and work runs from February 25 to no later than August 4, 2021.
